Description: Dual positive-edge-triggered D flip-flop with asynchronous preset and clear
Notes: Provides the S A and B state registers; tie unused flip-flop inputs to defined levels.
Three gates implement A(next) B(next) and the S XOR term.
One gate implements X AND B.
Decodes the three stored state bits to one selected display output.
Debounces and inverts the manual clock signal.
Connect anodes through R1-R8 to +5 V and cathodes to the active-low 74LS138 outputs.
About 6 mA with a typical red LED; suitable for 74LS138 output sinking.
Defines X and Y as logic 0 when their switches are open.
Used with SW3 and C1 in the debounce network.
Holds the active-low 74LS74 clear inputs inactive when SW4 is open.
Use with R11 and U6; adjust if the selected switch needs a longer debounce interval.
Install one directly across the 5 V and GND pins of each TTL IC.
Connect each switch from +5 V to X or Y; R9-R10 pull the inputs low.
Connect to the R11/C1/U6 debounce node; one press advances one state.
Connect from the shared active-low clear net to GND; clears the state to 000.
Use a regulated supply suitable for 74LS TTL.
Assembly platform; a PCB may be substituted.

Value / part number: 28 AWG solid insulated; red black green yellow blue white
Notes: Solder one end to each panel-switch terminal and wrap the other end onto a proper wire-wrap post. Reserve red for +5 V black for ground green for clock/control yellow for manual inputs blue for ordinary state/logic and white for active-low signals.
Optional one-shot stage if the debounced pushbutton must guarantee a single fixed-width clock pulse.
